feeds.title: Dream Views - Lucid Dreaming
feeds.description: Dreamviews is the largest Lucid Dreaming Community and Resource on the web. Follow blog and get information about lucid dreaming, controlling dreams, sleep stages, dream signs, dream interpretation and more.

feeds.title: Jane Teresa Anderson Blog
feeds.description: Meet Jane Teresa Anderson BSc Hons, a dream analyst, dream therapist, writer, and mentor residing in Hobart, Australia. She offers consultations, training, and mentoring services to clients worldwide. Jane Teresa's approach to dream analysis, dream therapy, and dream alchemy is grounded in her independent research and extensive experience working with clients since 1992. Dream analyst and author Jane Teresa Anderson blogs about dreams, dreaming, dream interpretation, and entertaining, playful, insights into daily life.

feeds.title: Dream Journal Blog
feeds.description: Dream Journal is a free service that allows you to create and customize your online dream journal. Share your dreams and update your journal as often as possible. Learn how to have lucid dreams, out-of-body experiences, and more. It's fun, free, and easy to use! Track dream trends, compare plans, search other's dreams, request interpretations, participate in our dream discussion forum, and more.

feeds.title: The Robert Moss - Blog
feeds.description: Robert Moss describes himself as a dream teacher, on a path for which there has been no career track in our culture. He is the creator of Active Dreaming, an original synthesis of dreamwork and shamanism.

feeds.title: Deep Lucid Dreaming Blog
feeds.description: Sleep and deep lucid dreaming. Sleep intelligence, creativity, sex dreams, nightmares, out of body experiences. Blog by Dr. Clare Johnson.

feeds.title: Mindful Lucid Dreaming Blog
feeds.description: Scientific, practical and personal perspectives on lucid dreaming by Kristen LaMarca PhD.

feeds.title: The Sleeping Third Blog
feeds.description: Allison is a dedicated advocate for sleep health and well-being, with a keen interest in exploring the fascinating realm of lucid dreaming. Her mission revolves around making the world of dreams and lucidity accessible to everyone through playful and creative approaches. Within her blog, readers will discover informative content on the significance of sleep, along with comprehensive guidance on understanding what lucid dreaming entails and how to achieve it consistently.

feeds.title: How To Lucid - Learn how to control your dreams! Blog
feeds.description: The worlds best lucid dreaming blog or website (probably). We cover every aspect of lucidity, dreams, and psychology. We can teach you how to control your dreams so you can do seemingly impossible things in your sleep. It feels AWESOME.

feeds.title: Lucid Dream Leaf
feeds.description: We are seeking to increase human consciousness through the medium of dreams. We have personally experienced several real-life applications of lucid dreaming and wish to help other people familiarize themselves with its benefits. The purpose of Dream Leaf is to help people experience incredible lucid dreams through the use of synergistic herbs.

feeds.title: Diaries of a dreamworm
feeds.description: What's stranger than fiction? Dreams! What's the biggest superpower? The ability to recall dreams. And, what's common to both? My blog, where I journal my dreams as I remember them. From an old fridge abandoned in the woods to a monster lurking in the toilet - my dreams can put the makers of sci-fi and surreal films out of business.

feeds.title: Lucid Sage Blog
feeds.description: As a kid I used to have many lucid dreams before ever knowing what a Lucid Dream really is. I thought it was natural, and though it wasn't very common, it was one of my favorite experiences. I've created this website as an active journal for my journey and hopefully a guide for anyone who wishes to learn how to lucid dream and join me on this path of discovery.

feeds.title: AstralWonders
feeds.description: Find all your answers about Astral Projection and Astral Travel.

feeds.title: Lucid Dream Catcher
feeds.description: Heyllo oneironaut, I am your host, Alexandra Starr, a 43 year old English transfemale lucid dreamer who is pretty new to lucid dreaming but who has studied and practised to become lucid for a couple of years, only recently gaining a foothold in the lucid dreaming game.

feeds.title: Vivid Dreams
feeds.description: We all have dreams; longings to be and to experience more. Yet, we often don't know how to make those dreams come true. This website provides guiding steps to materialize your desires into reality.

feeds.title: Lucid Advice
feeds.description: Author of the acclaimed book, Lucid Dreaming: Gateway to the Inner Self, and co-editor of the free quarterly magazine, Lucid Dreaming Experience.

feeds.title: Lucid Dreaming
feeds.description: I started this blog in 2007 to fill a need on the web for reliable and expert information about dream science, especially lucid dreaming, nightmares, and related altered states of consciousness.

feeds.title: The Dreams Maven Blog
feeds.description: This website has been set up by me, Delphi Ellis, as a dedicated resource to the subject of sleep and dreams; to help us along the adventure of exploring and making sense of them.

feeds.title: LUCID DREAM RESEARCH
feeds.description: This is a network for lucid dreamers and scientists to share research information and lucid dream experiences, connect for future studies, and expand the knowledge of the lucid dream phenomenon.

feeds.title: Wishful Thinking Blog
feeds.description: Can't do it in real life? Do it on WT. Here, the authors shares all their dreams and fantasies Follow the blog to get new content delivered directly to your inbox.

feeds.title: Dream Studies
feeds.description: Rekindle your dream life and wake up to what matters most Welcome to Dream Studies. I'm Ryan Hurd. This is a place for waking up your dreaming mind...

feeds.title: Kelly Bulkeley
feeds.description: This website is for anyone who is interested in dreams and wants to learn more about current research on dreams in relation to psychology, religion, evolutionary science, politics, art, and culture.

feeds.title: Pamela Cummins Blog
feeds.description: Pamela Cummins teaches dream interpretation, does dream analysis by email and sessions, educates with classes and workshops, dream books.

feeds.title: David L. Rivinus - Do you dream?
feeds.description: Hello! Welcome to my blog about dream interpretation. My name is David Rivinus and I'm a dream analyst with over 40 years of experience. On this blog you can read dreams and their interpretations. You can also follow discussions and theories of the interpretation process--including some unusual ideas about what constitutes a dream.

feeds.title: Lucid Dream School
feeds.description: The Lucid Dream School is a resource site dedicated to the act of 'Lucid Dreaming'. Often called 'conscious dreaming' it is defined as a dream in which the dreamer is aware that he or she is dreaming. On this site, you will find techniques, articles, books, music and recommended products and books to help you in your lucid dreaming endeavors.

feeds.title: Dream Labs
feeds.description: DreamLabs.io is a revolutionary new website that dares to push the limits of dreaming.
